subject: Re: Transformers for HV installation and commissioning
quote: Thanks for the introduction. Please send datasheets, model-specific
body_excerpt:
Hi Ian,

Thanks for the introduction. Please send datasheets, model-specific
certification documents showing Canadian applicability, and a sample
factory test report for your 60 Hz padmount and substation transformers.

Please include available voltage and kVA ranges, lead times, Canadian
warranty/service support and quotation terms. Any product would require a
project-specific review before selection.

Thanks,
Zac
Zeus Electric & Controls Inc.

our_reply.summary: 已按要求附上 datasheets / UL+cUL 证书（E541626、E541627，均含加拿大）/ 样品出厂试验报告 / 保修函 / 安装手册 / 参考名录；并逐项回应：容量区间（三相美变 45–5000 kVA、cUL 75–3000 kVA；变电站变 750 kVA–110 MVA，HV 72–121 kV）、交期 5–7 周（自图纸确认起）、海运费另计、可安排见证 FAT、保修 2 年（自交付起）、加拿大 Burlington ON 有办事处可提供本地售后、报价条款 FOB Shanghai / 30% 定金 + 70% 发货前 / 报价有效期 30 天
